dedupe_keys.name: transitioning from modis to viirs global water reservoir product

description: Transitioning from MODIS to VIIRS Global Water Reservoir Product is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Deep Shah et al. Reservoirs regulate water availability and can improve water security. Here, we develop NASA’s Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) based Global Water Reservoir (GWR) product, consisting of measurements of reservoir area, elevation, storage, evaporation rate, and evaporation loss for 164 large global reservoirs. The dataset is available at 8-day and monthly temporal resolutions. Coverage: global; published in 2024. Formats: PDF. The data are held in NASA Earthdata and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
